requirements.description: Release evidence shall identify the tested software baseline.
Corrective actions shall record effectiveness evidence before closure.
Serialized inspection records shall be traceable to delivered units.
requirements.verification_method: trace inspection record to serial number

requirements.description: Audit findings shall link to an owned follow-up action.
requirements.verification_method: review audit finding and action linkage

complaints.summary: Release evidence referenced an outdated software baseline.
Inspection report could not be traced to one synthetic unit serial.
Document package used inconsistent file naming.

eight_d_records.team: quality engineer, software lead, configuration owner
eight_d_records.problem_statement: One release package referenced a superseded baseline.
eight_d_records.containment_action: Hold package release and verify every baseline reference.
eight_d_records.root_cause: The evidence checklist did not require an automated baseline comparison.
eight_d_records.corrective_action: Add baseline comparison and independent evidence review.
eight_d_records.validation_evidence: Two synthetic release packages passed the revised check.

eight_d_records.team: quality engineer, hardware lead, inspection owner
eight_d_records.problem_statement: One inspection record lacked a serial-number linkage.
eight_d_records.containment_action: Quarantine the affected synthetic record and verify the batch.

eight_d_records.problem_statement: Package files used two naming patterns.
eight_d_records.containment_action: Rename files and review the complete package.
eight_d_records.root_cause: The working practice did not define a controlled naming pattern.
eight_d_records.corrective_action: Publish one naming convention and add a checklist item.
eight_d_records.validation_evidence: The corrected package passed an independent review.
eight_d_records.preventive_action: Apply the convention to all active synthetic project folders.

corrective_actions.description: Add an automated baseline comparison to the release evidence checklist.
Perform an independent review of the next three evidence packages.
Reconcile inspection records with the synthetic serial-number register.
Publish and review the controlled document naming convention.
Link every audit finding to an owned corrective action.

risks.description: A mismatched software baseline could enter the customer evidence package.
risks.mitigation: Automated comparison plus independent release review.

risks.description: Inspection evidence may not retain unit-level traceability.
risks.mitigation: Mandatory serial field and batch reconciliation review.

risks.description: Inconsistent file names may delay document-package review.
risks.mitigation: Controlled naming convention and checklist review.

audits.scope: Corrective-action ownership, evidence and closure records

findings.description: One historical finding lacked a named action owner.
Effectiveness evidence should use a consistent reference format.

audits.scope: Software release evidence, requirements traceability and 8D follow-up
